units.title: Verify: Over-limit message and submit block unit tests

tests.id: contributionMaxLength > over limit: 501 characters block submit
tests.name: 501 characters show "Too long: 501 / 500" and block submit
tests.title: Over-limit message appears and submit is blocked at 501 characters
tests.scenario: Given the sheet is open, When 501 characters are entered and Send is clicked, Then the alert reads 'Too long: 501 / 500', the textarea is aria-invalid, submit is not called, and the value keeps 501 characters

tests.name: 500 characters show no limit message and submit the full string
tests.title: 500 characters show no limit message and submit
tests.scenario: Given 500 characters are entered, When Send is clicked, Then no 'Too long' message is shown and submit is called once with the 500-character string

tests.id: contributionMaxLength > over limit: 501 to 500 clears message
tests.name: changing from 501 to 500 characters removes the limit message
tests.title: Limit message clears when the text drops from 501 to 500 characters
tests.scenario: Given the message shows at 501 characters, When the text is changed to 500 characters, Then the 'Too long' message is removed

tests.id: contributionMaxLength > over limit: 500 plus spaces submits trimmed
tests.name: 500 characters plus surrounding spaces still submit the trimmed 500-character string
tests.title: 500 characters with surrounding spaces still submit after trimming
tests.scenario: Given 500 characters padded with spaces, When Send is clicked, Then no limit message is shown and submit is called once with the trimmed 500-character string

tests.title: Blank submit behavior is preserved
tests.scenario: Given the existing blank-submit suite, When it runs unchanged, Then all 5 tests pass
